p3/esc207:10.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:10.text: I imagine that can create some stress?

p3/esc207:11.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:11.text: No not really it's all good over here.

p3/esc207:12.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:12.text: Well I'm glad to hear it, sounds like you've been managing pretty well then.

p3/esc207:13.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:13.text: Yes because I am on winter break now.

p3/esc207:14.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:14.text: I assume that means you're in college then? So the stress of finals is over now?

p3/esc207:15.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:15.text: Yes I am. And yeah I just finished finals.

p3/esc207:16.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:16.text: That's good, I hope they went well for you.

p3/esc207:17.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:17.text: They did. Some were hard, but at least they're over now.

p3/esc207:18.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:18.text: Yes, now you can relax and spend time with your family without the added stress.

p3/esc207:2.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:2.text: I'm glad to hear you're doing well in these trying times.

p3/esc207:20.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:20.text: Well I hope you and your family enjoy the holidays and stay safe.

p3/esc207:26.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:26.text: Absolutely, the best thing we can do right now. Even though it's kind of a bummer.

p3/esc207:27.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:27.text: Yeah, hopefully things will go back to normal soon.

p3/esc207:28.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:28.text: I hope so too, this has been such a crazy year.

p3/esc207:4.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:4.text: How have you been managing everything?

p3/esc207:5.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:5.text: Fine I've been pretty much just trying to go out as little as possible and stay safe.

p3/esc207:6.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:6.text: Same here, it's a tough time to do that after doing it so long. Especially with the holidays coming up.

p3/esc207:7.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:7.text: Yes I would have to agree.

p3/esc207:8.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:8.text: Are you in close proximity to your family?

p3/esc207:9.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:9.text: Yeah I'm staying with them for the holidays and then going back home in January.

p3/esc471:10.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:10.text: What do you think I should do then?

p3/esc471:11.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:11.text: I understand, school was tough for me too.

p3/esc471:12.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:12.text: I suggest you tell them to knock it off or you can sit somewhere away from the bus.

p3/esc471:13.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:13.text: Should I just beat them up with my backpack

p3/esc471:14.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:14.text: No, beating them up will only get you in trouble and that won't help.

p3/esc471:15.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:15.text: There's another bus route. Should I just take that instead

p3/esc471:16.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:16.text: I think that could be a good idea if it's not too far out of your way.

p3/esc471:17.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:17.text: I think I will. Their comments make me very insecure

p3/esc471:18.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:18.text: You could also tell a teacher what is happening. They will help you out.

p3/esc471:19.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:19.text: I bet you are handsome! Don't let it get to you.

p3/esc471:2.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:2.text: I'm doing good. I need some advice

p3/esc471:20.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:20.text: The teacher would probably make fun of me!

p3/esc471:21.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:21.text: Thanks it's hard to look in the mirror now

p3/esc471:22.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:22.text: Try to tell yourself you are good looking and deserve good things to happen every morning! Look in that mirror and tell yourself good things.

p3/esc471:23.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:23.text: I'll try to be positive for once.

p3/esc471:24.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:24.text: Do you believe working out will help

p3/esc471:25.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:25.text: Working out will help a lot! When I was feeling down on myself I decided to go to the gym three times a week. It was a great confidence boost.

p3/esc471:26.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:26.text: Awesome. I will start to take care of myself and not worry about others then.

p3/esc471:27.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:27.text: That sounds like a fantastic idea.

p3/esc471:3.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:3.text: What can I help you with?

p3/esc471:4.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:4.text: Lately, my friends started to make jokes about my face being ugly. They even called my face as flat as a pan! What should I do? I see them everyday on the bus

p3/esc471:5.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:5.text: Have you tried confronting them and asking why they are being bullies?

p3/esc471:6.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:6.text: I did and they respond by saying that they are just joking and that I'm handsome. But it's starting to get on my nerves because it's all they make fun about every time they see me!

p3/esc471:7.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:7.text: I'm sure you are very handsome! They could just be jealous.

p3/esc471:9.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:9.text: Still though, it makes me want to avoid them when I go to school on the bus

p3/esc51:0.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:0.text: Hello, how is your life at the moment? Do you want to talk about anything?

p3/esc51:1.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:1.text: I am doing ok. I just broke up with my girlfriend and sad about it

p3/esc51:10.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:10.text: Well, I think you should give her some space but people do sometimes get back together after they've separated

p3/esc51:12.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:12.text: You really do need to give her some space though - don't crowd her

p3/esc51:13.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:13.text: Should I call her directly? What should I say?

p3/esc51:14.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:14.text: I would give her a little time. Maybe two or three days? She might need some time to clear her head

p3/esc51:15.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:15.text: That's a good idea. What should I say? Should I apologize?

p3/esc51:16.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:16.text: Perhaps you could send flowers and a note asking her if she'd like to talk?

p3/esc51:17.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:17.text: That's a good idea. I will try that. Thank you.

p3/esc51:18.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:18.text: She might be feeling receptive to that but if she's not you might have to accept that it's over.

p3/esc51:2.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:2.text: so I hear you are not feeling at all your best at the moment?

p3/esc51:4.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:4.text: Do you feel as though you have no-one to talk to about this situation? I am happy to listen.

p3/esc51:5.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:5.text: I am so sad and just wonder why did it happen!!!

p3/esc51:6.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:6.text: Do you have no idea? Do you think you might have done something wrong or perhaps she was being unfaithful to you?

p3/esc51:7.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:7.text: We had simple disagreement and both of us were keep fighting.. now I can not get over it.

p3/esc51:8.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:8.text: Do you consider that there might be any hope for the  two of you at all?

p3/esc51:9.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:9.text: I don't know. What should I do?

p3/esc844:0.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:0.text: Hi, what I can help you with today?

p3/esc844:10.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:10.text: But nobody even pointed that why I'm failing, they just didn't care

p3/esc844:11.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:11.text: I agree it is a lot of pressure, but do not let bad teachers deter you. I would reach out to a school counselor and let them know your situation. Every school must have one.

p3/esc844:12.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:12.text: Also, physics is a difficult course to study, but if you chose it, that means you have a very strong mind.

p3/esc844:13.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:13.text: I loved physics a lot more than now, but what's the point of studying when the teachers are pulsing you not to study! (because of the quality of teaching)

p3/esc844:14.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:14.text: I hope there was someone, but I don't think we have a counselor

p3/esc844:15.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:15.text: More reason to speak to a school counselor or school administrator. We need to provide help to students, not have bad teachers deter them.

p3/esc844:16.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:16.text: Yeah, same with me! I wish I could attend a better univeristy

p3/esc844:17.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:17.text: What made you choose this particular university you are at?

p3/esc844:18.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:18.text: I didn't have another choice but this

p3/esc844:19.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:19.text: Have you looked into other Universities for the possibility of transferring

p3/esc844:2.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:2.text: I had problems in the past and somehow right now

p3/esc844:20.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:20.text: Hmmm, actually I didn't think about this option

p3/esc844:21.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:21.text: Just think about what you want in a good university and research from there

p3/esc844:24.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:24.text: you've been more helpful than my teachers!

p3/esc844:25.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:25.text: You're welcome I hope you find the perfect university for you

p3/esc844:26.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:26.text: Thanks, I wish  you luck in your future endeavours

p3/esc844:3.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:3.text: What sort of problems were in your past and now?

p3/esc844:4.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:4.text: I loved physics and I decided to attend university, but soon after I slowly lost my interest and became unmotivated

p3/esc844:5.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:5.text: What was happening in your life that made you lose interest?

p3/esc844:6.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:6.text: Actually the professors and the class atmosphere was the reason, and of course the quality of teaching

p3/esc844:7.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:7.text: so I started to skipping the classes and failing

p3/esc844:8.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:8.text: It sounds like that is a lot of reasons to be stressed. Have you spoken to a school counselor?

p3/esc844:9.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:9.text: Yes lots of stress and pressure. I did not, because we didn't have such things or at least I wasn't aware

p3/p3_conv_10:0.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:0.text: Hey, do you have a moment to talk?

p3/p3_conv_10:1.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:1.text: Of course, Nick. What's on your mind?

p3/p3_conv_10:10.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:10.text: Yeah, I think that's a good idea. It's just hard because I really value their opinion, but I also know I have to live my own life.

p3/p3_conv_10:11.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:11.text: Balancing your own needs with family expectations can be challenging, but it's crucial to stay true to yourself.

p3/p3_conv_10:12.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:12.text: I know. And I can't help but feel like I'm disappointing them sometimes.

p3/p3_conv_10:13.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:13.text: It's understandable to feel that way, but remember, you're making decisions that are best for you and your future.

p3/p3_conv_10:14.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:14.text: Thanks for reminding me of that. It's just not easy, you know?

p3/p3_conv_10:15.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:15.text: Absolutely, I get it. It won't always feel easy, but you're building a life you believe in. That's something to be proud of.

p3/p3_conv_10:16.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:16.text: You're right. And I have people like you and Sally who understand and support me.

p3/p3_conv_10:17.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:17.text: That's so important, Nick. Surrounding yourself with supportive people can make a huge difference. You're not alone in this.

p3/p3_conv_10:18.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:18.text: Thanks. I appreciate having someone to talk to who understands.

p3/p3_conv_10:19.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:19.text: Anytime, Nick. I'm here whenever you need to talk. You're doing great, really.

p3/p3_conv_10:2.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:2.text: It's my family. We had a pretty big falling out recently over some differences in lifestyle choices.

p3/p3_conv_10:3.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:3.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Family conflicts can be really tough to deal with. Do you want to share more about what happened?

p3/p3_conv_10:4.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:4.text: Well, it's just... they don't really agree with how I'm choosing to live my life now that I'm at university, especially with my decision to switch majors and my relationship with Sally.

p3/p3_conv_10:5.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:5.text: It sounds like they're having a hard time accepting your choices. That's really frustrating, especially when you're trying to follow your own path.

p3/p3_conv_10:6.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:6.text: Exactly. I just feel like they don't understand my perspective or even try to.

p3/p3_conv_10:7.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:7.text: Have you been able to communicate how you're feeling to them, or what these choices mean to you?

p3/p3_conv_10:8.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_10:8.text: I tried, but it just ended up becoming another argument. I honestly feel worn out trying to explain myself sometimes.

p3/p3_conv_10:9.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_10:9.text: It's important to take care of yourself first. Maybe giving everyone some space could help calm things down before the next conversation.

p3/p3_conv_11:0.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:0.text: Hey, do you have a moment to chat?

p3/p3_conv_11:1.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:1.text: Of course, Nick! What's on your mind?

p3/p3_conv_11:10.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:10.text: Yeah, I was thinking about that. I just get nervous about reaching out.

p3/p3_conv_11:11.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:11.text: It's understandable to feel nervous. Remember how you rekindled things with Sally—taking small steps can lead to meaningful connections.

p3/p3_conv_11:12.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:12.text: You're right. That took some courage, and it really paid off in the end.

p3/p3_conv_11:13.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:13.text: Absolutely. You've shown before that you can handle stepping outside your comfort zone.

p3/p3_conv_11:14.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:14.text: Thanks for reminding me. I think I just need to trust myself more.

p3/p3_conv_11:15.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:15.text: Exactly. And remember, it's okay if things don't go perfectly at first. It's all about making genuine efforts.

p3/p3_conv_11:16.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:16.text: True, I'll keep that in mind. I'll try to reach out to Alex next week.

p3/p3_conv_11:17.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:17.text: That's a solid plan. I'm proud of you for taking this step, Nick.

p3/p3_conv_11:18.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:18.text: Thanks, that means a lot. I'll keep you posted on how it goes.

p3/p3_conv_11:19.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:19.text: I'm always here to listen. Good luck!

p3/p3_conv_11:2.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:2.text: I've been feeling a bit disconnected lately, even though I joined a new club at university.

p3/p3_conv_11:3.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Joining a club was a great step, though. What's been making you feel disconnected?

p3/p3_conv_11:4.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:4.text: I guess it's just hard to break the ice. Everyone seems to know each other already.

p3/p3_conv_11:5.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:5.text: I get that. It can be tough when it feels like you're the odd one out. Have you managed to talk to anyone there yet?

p3/p3_conv_11:6.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:6.text: I've talked to a few people, but the conversations were pretty surface level.

p3/p3_conv_11:7.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:7.text: That can definitely make it feel isolating. Were there any members who seemed particularly approachable?

p3/p3_conv_11:8.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_11:8.text: There was this one guy, Alex, who seemed friendly. We talked a bit about our coursework.

p3/p3_conv_11:9.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_11:9.text: That's a great start! Maybe you could suggest grabbing coffee or doing something casual outside the club to get to know each other better?

p3/p3_conv_12:0.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:0.text: Hey Nick, how's everything going? I've been thinking about our last chat.

p3/p3_conv_12:1.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:1.text: Hey, I'm alright... kind of. There’s a bit of tension between Sally and me.

p3/p3_conv_12:10.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:10.text: That's understandable. It's great that you're aware of those patterns. Growth comes from understanding and adjusting, right?

p3/p3_conv_12:11.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:11.text: Exactly. I’m just scared that our past issues could resurface, even though we’re in a better place now.

p3/p3_conv_12:12.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:12.text: That fear can be overwhelming. But remember how you got through those issues before. You both worked hard to communicate better.

p3/p3_conv_12:13.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:13.text: True, we have. I think I just need to be better at balancing everything.

p3/p3_conv_12:14.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:14.text: Finding that balance is key, and you're already considering it. Have you thought about planning specific times for hobbies and for Sally?

p3/p3_conv_12:15.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:15.text: That's a good idea. I could set certain days where we spend more quality time together.

p3/p3_conv_12:16.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:16.text: That sounds like a great plan. I'm sure she'd appreciate knowing she's a priority.

p3/p3_conv_12:17.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:17.text: Thanks for the advice. It just feels good to talk it out. I feel a bit more confident about addressing it now.

p3/p3_conv_12:18.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:18.text: Anytime, Nick. Remember, relationships grow stronger with communication and effort. You’re doing great.

p3/p3_conv_12:19.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:19.text: Thanks, I really appreciate it. I’ll give her a call and see if we can plan something.

p3/p3_conv_12:2.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What's been going on between you two?

p3/p3_conv_12:20.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:20.text: That sounds like a solid step. I’m here if you need to talk more about it later.

p3/p3_conv_12:21.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:21.text: I will. Thanks for the support. It means a lot.

p3/p3_conv_12:3.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:3.text: Well, I’ve been spending a lot of time exploring my new hobbies since I joined that club.

p3/p3_conv_12:4.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:4.text: It's great that you're diving into your interests! How is Sally feeling about it?

p3/p3_conv_12:5.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:5.text: She's supportive, but I think she feels a bit neglected because I’m spending less time with her.

p3/p3_conv_12:6.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:6.text: Balancing hobbies and relationships can be tricky. Have you two talked about it?

p3/p3_conv_12:7.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:7.text: We’ve talked a little, but I get the sense she’s not saying everything she feels.

p3/p3_conv_12:8.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_12:8.text: It sounds like it might help to have an honest chat. It could help both of you express what's really on your minds.

p3/p3_conv_12:9.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_12:9.text: Yeah, you’re right. I guess I’m worried about hurting her feelings or repeating past mistakes.

p3/p3_conv_13:0.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:0.text: Hey Nick! How's everything going lately?

p3/p3_conv_13:1.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_13:1.text: Hi. It's been a bit of a whirlwind, to be honest. My professor suggested I participate in some academic research opportunities.

p3/p3_conv_13:10.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:10.text: That's great to hear! Maybe it's about finding that balance between academics and your personal life. Have you thought about how to fit in the research?

p3/p3_conv_13:11.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_13:11.text: That's the tricky part. I don't want to let go of the things that are making me happier just to keep up academically.

p3/p3_conv_13:12.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:12.text: It makes sense. Prioritizing your well-being is crucial. Perhaps you could talk with your professor about a more flexible arrangement?

p3/p3_conv_13:13.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_13:13.text: That's a good idea. She's been supportive before, so maybe she'd understand. I just feel like I need to prove myself somehow.

p3/p3_conv_13:14.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:14.text: It's natural to want to prove yourself, especially when given opportunities. But remember, you're already doing a lot by managing a new major and social life.

p3/p3_conv_13:15.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_13:15.text: True, I guess I'm still learning how to give myself credit for what I am handling.

p3/p3_conv_13:16.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:16.text: Absolutely. Give yourself that credit; you're achieving a lot. Taking on research is an achievement in itself, regardless of the extent of your involvement.

p3/p3_conv_13:17.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_13:17.text: Thanks for that reminder. I'll definitely consider talking to her about it. Ultimately, I don't want to miss out on something that could be great.

p3/p3_conv_13:18.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:18.text: That's a good mindset. Just take it step by step, and don't hesitate to reach out if you're feeling overwhelmed.

p3/p3_conv_13:19.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_13:19.text: I will. Thanks for listening and for all the advice. It really helps to talk it out.

p3/p3_conv_13:2.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:2.text: That sounds like a great opportunity! How are you feeling about it?

p3/p3_conv_13:3.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_13:3.text: Well, I'm quite flattered that she thought of me, but I'm also really nervous about the added responsibilities.

p3/p3_conv_13:4.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:4.text: It's completely natural to feel that way. What specifically makes you nervous about getting involved?

p3/p3_conv_13:5.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_13:5.text: I'm worried about balancing my current workload with the research. Last time I felt overwhelmed, I nearly dropped a course.

p3/p3_conv_13:6.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_13:6.text: I remember when you were dealing with that. It must feel daunting to think about adding more. What does your schedule look like right now?

p3/p3_conv_13:7.speaker: seeker

p3/p3_conv_7:1.text: Of course, Nick! What's on your mind?

p3/p3_conv_7:10.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:10.text: Not as much as I should be. I know it matters, but it's hard to prioritize.

p3/p3_conv_7:11.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:11.text: It's definitely hard to balance, especially with everything else you're managing. Maybe starting with small breaks could help?

p3/p3_conv_7:12.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:12.text: Yeah, I think I could start with just a few minutes to breathe. It's worth trying.

p3/p3_conv_7:13.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:13.text: Absolutely! Sometimes the smallest changes make a big difference. How's your relationship with your professors, now that you've switched majors?

p3/p3_conv_7:14.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:14.text: Better actually, they've been a lot more approachable in the new department.

p3/p3_conv_7:15.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:15.text: That's great to hear! Having supportive professors can really make a difference. Are you comfortable reaching out to them if you need help?

p3/p3_conv_7:16.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:16.text: I think so. It's still new to me, but knowing they're there is reassuring.

p3/p3_conv_7:17.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:17.text: It's good to have that support system. Remember that asking for help is a strength, not a weakness.

p3/p3_conv_7:18.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:18.text: Thanks, I need to remind myself of that sometimes. It's easy to forget.

p3/p3_conv_7:19.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:19.text: Totally normal to forget. Just know you're doing the best you can, and that's enough.

p3/p3_conv_7:2.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:2.text: I've been feeling a bit all over the place lately.

p3/p3_conv_7:20.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:20.text: Thanks, I really appreciate you listening. It's helped clear my head a bit.

p3/p3_conv_7:21.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:21.text: I'm glad I could be here for you. You're doing great, Nick!

p3/p3_conv_7:22.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:22.text: Thanks! I'll definitely work on taking those small breaks.

p3/p3_conv_7:23.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:23.text: Great plan! Let me know how it goes, and always feel free to reach out whenever you need to chat.

p3/p3_conv_7:24.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:24.text: Will do. Thanks again for everything.

p3/p3_conv_7:3.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:3.text: I'm here for you. Can you tell me more about what's been going on?

p3/p3_conv_7:4.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:4.text: Well, since switching my major to psychology, things have been mostly positive, but I'm just juggling a lot.

p3/p3_conv_7:5.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:5.text: It makes sense that you'd feel that way, especially during a big transition like that. How are you managing the workload now?

p3/p3_conv_7:6.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:6.text: It's more manageable than physics, for sure. But I still get anxious about falling behind.

p3/p3_conv_7:7.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:7.text: That anxiety is understandable. It's a lot to handle. Have you found any new strategies that help with the anxiety?

p3/p3_conv_7:8.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:8.text: I've been trying to stay organized with a planner, but sometimes it feels overwhelming.

p3/p3_conv_7:9.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:9.text: Organization can be really helpful, but it's important to avoid burnout. Are you taking time for yourself, too?

p3/p3_conv_8:0.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:0.text: Hey, Nick! How are you holding up these days?

p3/p3_conv_8:1.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:1.text: Hey! Overall, I'm doing okay, but there's something on my mind recently.

p3/p3_conv_8:10.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:10.text: Open communication is a positive sign. What kind of worries linger for you?

p3/p3_conv_8:11.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:11.text: I think it's the fear of not being able to handle disagreements productively.

p3/p3_conv_8:12.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:12.text: That's a valid concern. Disagreements are normal, but it sounds like you both have grown. How did you handle the arguments before?

p3/p3_conv_8:13.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:13.text: We used to just shut down or lash out. But this time, we addressed a few small things calmly.

p3/p3_conv_8:14.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:14.text: It seems like both of you are putting in effort to handle things differently. Have you felt things improve in other areas as well?

p3/p3_conv_8:15.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:15.text: Yes, we're more supportive of each other's goals now. She's genuinely interested in my new major, which means a lot.

p3/p3_conv_8:16.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:16.text: That's wonderful to hear, Nick. Feels like a healthier connection. Do you still carry some anxiety about the future?

p3/p3_conv_8:17.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:17.text: Definitely, but I think I'm learning to trust the process and our growth, you know?

p3/p3_conv_8:18.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:18.text: It sounds like you're on a good path. Remember, progress and growth take time, and it's okay to have those ups and downs.

p3/p3_conv_8:19.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:19.text: Thanks, I needed to hear that. I think I just have to take things one step at a time.

p3/p3_conv_8:2.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:2.text: I'm here to listen, Nick. What's been on your mind?

p3/p3_conv_8:20.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:20.text: Exactly, one step at a time. You're doing great, Nick. How about other areas like your academics? How’ve they been?

p3/p3_conv_8:21.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:21.text: They're improving since I switched my major. I feel more invested in what I'm learning now.

p3/p3_conv_8:22.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:22.text: That's fantastic progress and it sounds like you're finding your footing both academically and personally.

p3/p3_conv_8:23.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:23.text: Yeah, it's coming together slowly. Thanks so much for listening. It really helps to talk it out.

p3/p3_conv_8:24.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:24.text: Anytime, Nick. I’m here for you whenever you need someone to listen. Keep me updated!

p3/p3_conv_8:25.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:25.text: I will, thank you! I'll keep working on staying positive.

p3/p3_conv_8:3.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:3.text: Well, I reconnected with my ex-girlfriend, and it's been a bit of an emotional rollercoaster.

p3/p3_conv_8:4.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:4.text: That sounds like a big step. How do you feel about reconnecting with her?

p3/p3_conv_8:5.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:5.text: I feel relieved in some ways. We've both grown and matured since our breakup, but it's also scary.

p3/p3_conv_8:6.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:6.text: It's understandable to have mixed feelings. What scares you about it?

p3/p3_conv_8:7.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:7.text: I guess I'm afraid of falling back into the same patterns we had before.

p3/p3_conv_8:8.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:8.text: That makes sense. Can you see any changes in how you're both approaching things this time?

p3/p3_conv_8:9.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:9.text: Yeah, we've been communicating better—a lot more openly and honestly. It feels good, but there's some lingering worry.

p3/p3_conv_9:0.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:0.text: Hey. I felt like I needed to talk to someone.

p3/p3_conv_9:1.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:1.text: Of course, Nick. What's been on your mind?

p3/p3_conv_9:10.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:10.text: I guess it's mostly about letting my guard down and fully trusting her again.

p3/p3_conv_9:11.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:11.text: Trust takes time to rebuild, but it seems like you're both committed to making it work.

p3/p3_conv_9:12.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:12.text: Yeah, she reassured me that we'll take things slow and focus on becoming better together.

p3/p3_conv_9:13.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:13.text: That's a great approach. Have you set any expectations or boundaries to help with this?

p3/p3_conv_9:14.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:14.text: We've talked about what bothered us before and are setting intentions to avoid those pitfalls this time.

p3/p3_conv_9:15.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:15.text: It sounds like you're both being proactive. That's going to make a big difference in the long run.

p3/p3_conv_9:16.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:16.text: I hope so. I really want this to work out because I still care about her a lot.

p3/p3_conv_9:17.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:17.text: That shows a lot of growth on your part, Nick. It's important to be patient with yourself and with Sally.

p3/p3_conv_9:18.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:18.text: Thank you. I'm learning to be patient. It's not easy, but I think it's worth it.

p3/p3_conv_9:19.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:19.text: It certainly is worth it. And remember, if you need support, you can always reach out.

p3/p3_conv_9:2.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:2.text: Well, Sally and I decided to give things another try.

p3/p3_conv_9:20.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:20.text: I appreciate that. It really helps to talk things out.

p3/p3_conv_9:21.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:21.text: Anytime, Nick. You're doing your best, and that's the most important part.

p3/p3_conv_9:3.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:3.text: That's a big step! How are you feeling about it?

p3/p3_conv_9:4.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:4.text: It's a mix of excitement and anxiety, honestly.

p3/p3_conv_9:5.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:5.text: That sounds understandable, given your past with Sally. How are you managing those feelings?

p3/p3_conv_9:6.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:6.text: I'm trying to focus on the progress we've made, but I'm scared of repeating old mistakes.

p3/p3_conv_9:7.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:7.text: Change can be tough, especially in relationships. What are some of the positive changes you've both made?

p3/p3_conv_9:8.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_9:8.text: We've become better at communicating. We listen to each other more now.

p3/p3_conv_9:9.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_9:9.text: That's really encouraging. Good communication is key. What are you worrying most about?
